title: Цена со скидкой
verify: SELECT name, pizza_name, price, discount_price FROM v_price_with_discount

negative.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_price_with_discount AS
SELECT person.name, menu.pizza_name, menu.price, menu.price - menu.price * 0.1 AS discount_price
FROM person_order
JOIN person ON person.id = person_order.person_id
JOIN menu ON menu.id = person_order.menu_id
ORDER BY person.name, menu.pizza_name;

CREATE VIEW v_price_with_discount AS
SELECT person.name, menu.pizza_name, menu.price, ROUND(menu.price - menu.price * 0.2) AS discount_price
FROM person_order
JOIN person ON person.id = person_order.person_id
JOIN menu ON menu.id = person_order.menu_id
ORDER BY person.name, menu.pizza_name;

CREATE VIEW v_price_with_discount AS
SELECT person.name, menu.pizza_name, menu.price, ROUND(menu.price - menu.price * 0.1) AS discount_price
FROM person_order
JOIN person ON person.id = person_order.person_id
JOIN menu ON menu.id = person_order.menu_id
ORDER BY menu.price;

CREATE VIEW v_price_with_discount AS
SELECT person.name, menu.pizza_name, menu.price, ROUND(menu.price - menu.price * 0.1) AS price_with_discount
FROM person_order
JOIN person ON person.id = person_order.person_id
JOIN menu ON menu.id = person_order.menu_id
ORDER BY person.name, menu.pizza_name;
